purpose: Keep the first genuine live counterparty artifact path blocked until staging, LEAP candidate preconditions, candidate challenge/replay, custody, response, intake, import, and computed-floor gates pass; a hash shell or LEAP candidate is not custody.

raw_payload_control.redacted_copy_boundary: redacted or pasted copies may support a public shell but cannot satisfy raw custody or create a response record

locks_release_only_after: raw payload has first been staged in a live evidence drop ledger by tools/prepare_first_real_artifact_pilot.py or tools/stage_live_evidence_drop.py and externalized to a private evidence vault when live-counterparty
raw payload locator and sha256 are present
request trace, counterparty contact, non-host retention, sealed/public parity, counterparty org, and dependency group are explicit before LEAP candidate state
candidate challenge/replay report rereads private-vault bytes; challenge pending stays reliance and silence is not waiver
class-specific authority and subject/representative authorization are present before custody/admission
cryptographic verifier adapter verifies payload, timestamp, and issuer key id
counterparty org, issuer key, dependency group, and host-correlation discount pass
sealed/public parity and failed-gate route are prepared

exit_criteria: LEAP candidate state is not custody; candidate challenge/replay must complete before custody review can proceed
candidate-artifact-received may proceed to custody only after all raw payload, authority, cryptographic, and independence slots are populated
rejected candidates must create or update a failed-gate public summary with no live-floor delta
admitted-to-custody still has no live-floor effect until response, intake, import gate, class-local replay, challenge/rollback, and computed snapshot pass
